qualifier_in_source: Do NOT generalize targeted discounting as a sustainable-growth strategy; retention -12%, cohort does not survive first renewal

judgments.note: Explicit prohibition against treating discounting as sustainable-growth lever, plus retention drop

'Unsustainable sugar high' plus retention loss and renewal death
'dies at renewal; unsustain' conveys the negative limit
